scope: Actual macOS NSWindow with reusable NativeHost, CPU softbuffer presentation, UI-tool keyboard/pointer and minimize/reopen; instrumented fixture-only probe
checks: OS key x updates first editor and summary
Shift+Tab/key z returns to first and clears modifier for next character
Pointer click/key w selects second; Escape/key v preserves ordinary input
Before fix:reopen focus2→-1→1 loses previous editor
After fix:reopen focus2→-1→2 restores previous editor; r updates second only
refocusImplementation: Remember last editable stable key on window blur; resolve unique editable/admitted target on focus regain; preserve key across duplicate blur and fall back to ordinary focus admission if unavailable.
limits: No actual CJK/marked-text IME candidate session, clipboard, accessibility tree or native DPI-change matrix
Probe uses reusable NativeHost; standalone forma main.rs has independent host and remains separate
No release/profile input latency claim; probe trace logging adds overhead
Missing/disabled/ambiguous restoration-key matrix and backend switches remain open
